_comment: Shared by the macOS and Windows apps. sizeGB = download size (Q4 default tag). minRAM = will load (may spill to CPU). recRAM = runs fully on the GPU with the agent's 16k context. rank = quality for the Infinite Agent (higher is better). paramsB = parameters (billions); activeB = parameters used per token for mixture-of-experts models (speed estimates).

models.name: Llama 3.2
models.summary: Tiny and instant. Good for quick lookups and short summaries; too small for careful trade reasoning.

models.name: Qwen3
models.summary: Smallest model with a thinking mode. Runs on almost anything.

models.name: Llama 3.2
models.summary: The site's default suggestion. Quick, light, follows instructions well for its size.

models.name: Gemma 3
models.summary: Small multimodal model with clear writing. Can read chart screenshots.

models.name: Qwen3
models.summary: Best quality for 8 GB Macs. Strong at numbers and step-by-step reasoning.

models.name: Llama 3.1
models.summary: Dependable all-rounder with a long context window.

models.name: Qwen2.5
models.summary: Answers straight away (no thinking step). Good with tables and market data.

models.name: DeepSeek-R1
models.summary: Thinks at length before answering. Thorough, but replies take longer.

models.name: Qwen3
models.summary: Best balance for 16 GB Macs: solid analysis, tool use and speed.

models.name: Mistral NeMo
models.summary: Fluent writer with a 128k context. Good for long reports.

models.name: Gemma 3
models.summary: Well-rounded multimodal model. Reads charts and explains them clearly.

models.name: Phi-4
models.summary: Strong at maths and logic for its size. Context is exactly the agent's 16k.

models.name: Qwen3
models.summary: Noticeably sharper analysis than 8B models. Great fit for 24 GB Macs.

models.name: gpt-oss
models.summary: OpenAI's open-weight model. Mixture-of-experts, so it is quick for its quality.

models.name: Gemma 3
models.summary: Google's largest open Gemma. Excellent writing and chart reading.

models.name: Qwen3
models.summary: Mixture-of-experts: near-32B quality at small-model speed. Top pick for 32 GB.

models.name: Qwen3
models.summary: Dense 32B model. The most careful analyst that fits a 48 GB Mac.

models.name: Llama 3.3
models.summary: Large, knowledgeable and steady. Needs a 64 GB Mac; replies are slower.

models.name: gpt-oss
models.summary: Frontier-class open model for 96 GB+ Macs. Closest to hosted AI quality.
